in_marathi.name: Avarthi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avarthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avarthi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Avarthana', meaning 'prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Avarthi is considered the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted with coins, jewels, and other symbols of wealth.
